text:
Alice M: quick draft of the release digest is up — can folks scan snippets/known-issues? https://redwood.docs/s/release/2026-03-digest
Ben T: looking now. flag: embedding size note is confusing to customers, we should show units (tokens vs dims)
Carla D: agreed. proposed edit: "Embeddings output is a 1024-dimensional vector (float32)." keeps it concrete.
Ben T: +1. also, add a note about compat with older SDKs (v0.8) — sometimes regen fails
Sam R: which SDK snippet needs a tweak? I can PR a small change
Alice M: the python example in the snippets section — it uses client.embed(text) but new SDK is client.embeddings.create(...)
Taylor S: I can swap that, also update pip install line to pin >=0.9.2
docs-bot: PR opened by Taylor S — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2482
Ben T: nice. can we also add an anchor for known-issues so sales can link directly? e.g., #known-issue-embeddings
Carla D: done in the draft, pinged legal for the wording about "temporary regressions" — awaiting reply
Alice M: timeline: want this live before Monday AM. any blockers?
Sam R: none from engineering. I'll run the snippet tests locally and post logs
Sam R: log: ```
pytest tests/snippets/test_embeddings.py::test_basic -k embeddings -q
All tests passed
```
Alice M: sweet. Ben, can you give final ack on wording?
Ben T: ack from me once Taylor's PR is merged and tests pass
Taylor S: merged and deployed to staging — preview: https://staging.redwood.docs/release/2026-03-digest
Alice M: thanks everyone :shipit:
